jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(4)(H) inventory: Sandgate School District, a town school district in the Southwest Vermont Supervisory Union (member town: Sandgate). Non-operating: tuitions all grades.
Town of Sandgate (official site; hosts the district's warning and minutes).

board.post_note: Sandgate SD: three directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a), one 3-year seat elected each year by Australian ballot.

sources.note: Sandgate SD FY27 warning (official, Town of Sandgate site): Article 3 elects "one School Board Director for a three-year term by Australian ballot March 3, 2026"; the signature block names the board -- Celeste Keel (Chairperson), Eric Weissleder (Vice Chairperson), Allan Tschorn (Clerk) -- the same three who signed the 2024 warning. The March 3, 2026 annual meeting minutes record all school board members in attendance but do not record the Article 3 ballot result. FLAG: which member's term was up in 2026 and the winner are established by no fetched document (resolving document: the Town Clerk's certified March 3, 2026 return); the three are minted with NO ends off the current roster.

directors.name: Eric Weissleder
directors.note: Vice Chairperson. No term end published.
